attchmntText: Bharat Rasayan Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Bharat Rasayan Limited approved its standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and six months ended 30th September 2026. The Board meeting was held on 13th November 2026. For the six months ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 69,098 lacs. Profit before tax stood at 8,260 lacs. Profit for the period was 8,195 lacs. Earnings per share were 37.27. Net worth was 1,30,944.64 lacs. The company reported no default on outstanding loans and debt securities. Related party transactions are applicable for the current quarter. The financial results are available on the NSE and company websites.
